name: BSP_EntityWorld_FlushActivations
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_world_entities, read-only analysis. __thiscall(this), RET (009036a8), no argument, ECX game+19CCh from BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e5382. Three callers: 004e4a40, BSP_Game_CheckMissionCompletion 004d7ea0 and 0046b730, so it is a flush several sites can force rather than a per-frame-only pass. Walks the intrusive chain from [this+4h] linked through node+38h and calls 00922fd0(node) when node+5Eh is set, node+6Ch is clear, and either node+3Ch is null or node+3Ch->5Eh is clear (00903680-009036a5). 00922fd0 sets +5Eh and +5Dh, clears +5Ch, latches +6Ch, recurses over children from node+48h linked through +44h for children whose +6Ch is clear, and tail-calls virtual +84h, so the outer walk skips any node reached as a child. game+19CCh is the same world object whose +4ACh byte gates BSP_EntityManager_Update 00481640; it is constructed at 004de686 with 004cb030 and initialised with 009037f0(1, 1). Supersedes the BSP_BotManager_Update proposal in docs/GAME_ON_MOVE_MAP.md, which rested on segment keywords alone. docs/GAME_WORLD_ENTITIES.md.

name: BSP_World_UpdateMatrixInterpolators
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol; the MatrixInterpolator half is recovered, from the Lua binding name AddMatrixInterpolator (008ADE00, registration table in src/mission_lua_host.cpp) and the literal 'luaMW_AddMatrixInterpolator failed:' in that binding. void __thiscall(world, float), RET 4 at 00904BE0, body 00904600..00904BE2. Sole caller 00904C2B in BSP_World_UpdateEntities. The float argument is dead: no read of the argument slot ESP+2FCh exists in the body, which works off the mission clock DAT_00F876A4 (0090462F). Walks the std::list at world+4B0h, base [_Myfirstiter 4B0h, _Myhead 4B4h, _Mysize 4B8h]; value 64h bytes at node+8, node 6Ch bytes (PUSH 6Ch at 009045C2 and the max_size guard 28F5C28h = FFFFFFFFh div 100 at 00904E70). Per record: elapsed = clock minus rec+60h; if the entity at rec+0h has byte_5Ch set, phase = clamp(elapsed div rec+1Ch, 0, 1) at 00904670..00904B84, both JBEs taken on an unordered compare so a NaN phase survives both clamps; compose RotZ(-phase*rec+18h) times RotY(-phase*rec+14h) times RotX(-phase*rec+10h) times Translate(phase * rec+4h..+0Ch) times rec+20h through four 00413920 calls at 00904AC3..00904AD8; entity->vtable[88h](result) at 00904AE3; clear entity+0C8h and +10Ch and run 0042ED50 over the child subtree at 00904AF7..00904B13; entity->vtable[0D8h]() at 00904B2A. Then re-read byte_5Ch at 00904B39 and erase when it is clear or elapsed is strictly greater than rec+1Ch. The erase continues the walk: the 12 bytes at 00904BCA..00904BD5 that Ghidra leaves undisassembled after the _free call are ADD ESP,4 / ADD [EDI+8],-1 / JMP 00904618, so any number of records can expire in one pass and _Mysize is decremented there. docs/WORLD_TIMED_ATTACHMENTS.md. | bsp_game.exe milestone 2i runs this pass at 00904c2b once per world walk. The list at world+4B0h is empty in a headless mission run of usn_2_java: its only producer is 00905080, the AddMatrixInterpolator Lua binding, which is one of the 560 binding rows and a host record, and no script of the mission called it, so the pass visits nothing and its four call sites are unreached. docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2i.

name: BSP_World_UpdateEntities
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this, float scaledDelta), RET 4, body 00904BF0..00904C34. ECX is [game+19CCh], the world object of docs/GAME_WORLD_CONSTRUCT.md; slot 0Ch of its vtable 00CE7784. Walks the child chain from [world+4] through entity+38h and calls entity->vtable[0DCh](delta) on every child whose byte at +5Ch is set, then 00904600(delta). The world destructor at 00904CD8 walks the same chain with FLDZ. docs/UNIT_INSTANCE_UPDATE.md. | Packet cc_world_update, full listing read (00904BF0..00904C34). The chain head is [[world+4]], a double indirection: 00904BF4 loads world+4 and 00904BF7 dereferences it. world+4 holds a 0Ch-byte header allocated by 009037F0, not an inline field of the world. The only gate in the body is the byte entity+5Ch at 00904C00; there is no paused, dead or culled test here (entity+5Eh is read by the world destructor at 00904CA4, not by this walk) and the pause gate is upstream in 004E50B0. The tail call 00904C2B is 00904600 BSP_World_UpdateMatrixInterpolators, which ignores the delta it is handed. docs/WORLD_ENTITY_UPDATE.md. | bsp_game.exe milestone 2i runs this walk every in-mission frame: 8960 entities visited and 8960 updated over 280 frames of usn_2_java, 32 per frame, none gated out at 00904c00 because every created unit's +5Ch is set. The executable owns the 0Ch chain header 009037f0 allocates at world+4h, which is the only field the walk reads from the world, so it runs while construct_world 004de610 is still a load record. docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2i.
